purpose: Verify viewing active announcements matching viewer targeting scope.
preconditions: User is authenticated; announcements matching user profile exist.
action_or_input: User requests announcement list.
expected_result: System returns relevant active announcements matching viewer role, program, and academic year.

purpose: Verify empty-state message when no relevant active announcements exist.
preconditions: No announcements exist matching viewer's targeting criteria.
action_or_input: User requests announcement list.
expected_result: System returns empty list with appropriate empty-state message.

purpose: Verify successful creation and publication of announcement with target scope.
preconditions: Faculty, Dept_Admin, or HOD is authenticated.
action_or_input: Actor submits complete announcement with title, content, and targeting info.
expected_result: Announcement is published in active state and notifications dispatched to target audience.

purpose: Verify announcement creation is blocked when required content or target information is invalid/missing.
preconditions: Actor is authenticated with announcement creation permission.
action_or_input: Actor submits announcement with empty title/content or invalid target criteria.
expected_result: System blocks publication (400 Bad Request) and returns validation feedback.

purpose: Verify HOD manages active announcement.
preconditions: Active announcement exists. HOD is authenticated.
action_or_input: HOD selects active announcement to manage.
expected_result: Permitted maintenance actions (Edit, Hide, Delete) are presented and accessible.

purpose: Verify HOD edits active announcement content and target information.
preconditions: Active announcement exists. HOD authenticated.
action_or_input: HOD updates announcement title and content.
expected_result: Announcement content is updated in persistence store.

purpose: Verify HOD hides an active announcement from normal viewing.
preconditions: Active announcement exists and is visible.
action_or_input: HOD triggers hide action on the announcement.
expected_result: Announcement status becomes HIDDEN; it no longer appears in normal user listings.

purpose: Verify HOD deletes an active announcement.
preconditions: Active announcement exists. HOD authenticated.
action_or_input: HOD triggers delete action on the announcement.
expected_result: Announcement is removed or deactivated and no longer retrievable in active lists.

purpose: Verify Faculty submits stock request with sufficient current inventory.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated. Inventory item has quantity 10.
action_or_input: Faculty requests quantity 4.
expected_result: Stock request created in 'Pending HOD Approval' state; Dept_Admin and HOD are notified.

purpose: Verify stock request is blocked when requested quantity exceeds current inventory.
preconditions: Faculty authenticated. Inventory item has quantity 2.
action_or_input: Faculty requests quantity 5.
expected_result: Request is not advanced to HOD approval; 400 Bad Request returned with insufficient inventory notice.

purpose: Verify HOD approves pending stock request.
preconditions: Stock request in 'Pending HOD Approval' state. HOD authenticated.
action_or_input: HOD approves the request.
expected_result: Request transitions to 'Approved for Issuance' and is made available to Dept_Admin.

purpose: Verify HOD rejects pending stock request.
preconditions: Stock request in 'Pending HOD Approval' state. HOD authenticated.
action_or_input: HOD rejects the request with remarks.
expected_result: Request transitions to 'Rejected' state and requesting Faculty is notified.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin allocates and issues approved stock request.
preconditions: Request is in 'Approved for Issuance' state. Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin confirms stock issuance.
expected_result: Request marked 'Issued', inventory decremented, immutable issuance log appended, and Faculty notified.

purpose: Verify Student or Faculty submits confidential feedback.
preconditions: Student or Faculty is authenticated.
action_or_input: Actor submits feedback with title, description, category.
expected_result: Feedback recorded in 'New' state, confidentiality preserved, and Dept_Admin notified.

purpose: Verify system handles failed feedback submission without recording partial state.
preconditions: Invalid payload missing mandatory fields (e.g. empty description).
action_or_input: Actor submits invalid feedback.
expected_result: Submission fails (400 Bad Request), no feedback record is persisted, and actor is informed.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin performs initial review and categorization of feedback.
preconditions: Feedback in 'New' state. Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin reviews feedback, assigns category, and updates status to 'Under Review'.
expected_result: Feedback status becomes 'UNDER_REVIEW' and categorized.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin closes simple feedback issue during initial review.
preconditions: Feedback in initial review. Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin marks simple issue as 'Closed' with resolution remarks.
expected_result: Feedback transitions to 'CLOSED' and submitter is notified.

purpose: Verify feedback remains non-terminal after initial review for further handling or HOD oversight.
preconditions: Feedback in initial review.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin categorizes feedback and leaves it under review.
expected_result: Feedback remains in 'UNDER_REVIEW' state and is available in HOD oversight queue.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin uploads and modifies conflict-free timetable.
preconditions: Dept_Admin authenticated. Slot times do not overlap with existing entries.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin uploads new or modified timetable schedule.
expected_result: Timetable entries are validated and saved successfully.

purpose: Verify slot conflict blocks timetable upload or modification.
preconditions: Existing slot in Room A from 09:00-10:00.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits schedule with overlapping slot in Room A from 09:30-10:30.
expected_result: System blocks save (400 Bad Request or 409 Conflict) and displays conflict details.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin updates general department information.
preconditions: Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin updates non-official fields (e.g. description, website).
expected_result: Department information is updated and live immediately.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin proposes an official department-detail change.
preconditions: Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin proposes official change (e.g. department name or policy).
expected_result: Proposal recorded in 'Pending HOD Approval' state; live data remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify department detail update validation failure is rejected.
preconditions: Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits invalid update payload (e.g. invalid email format or empty name).
expected_result: Update is not saved and validation feedback is shown (400 Bad Request).

purpose: Verify Faculty views department lab resource profiles and issued-stock history.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated. Lab resources and faculty issued stock exist.
action_or_input: Faculty requests lab resource list and stock history.
expected_result: System returns permitted lab resource profiles and faculty's own issued stock history.

purpose: Verify empty-state message when no lab resources or stock history exist.
preconditions: Faculty authenticated. No resources or stock history exist.
action_or_input: Faculty requests resource views.
expected_result: System displays an empty-state message without error.

purpose: Verify HOD approves pending official department change.
preconditions: Official change proposal in 'Pending HOD Approval' state. HOD authenticated.
action_or_input: HOD approves the proposal.
expected_result: Proposal transitions to Approved and official department detail becomes effective.

purpose: Verify HOD rejects pending official department change.
preconditions: Official change proposal in 'Pending HOD Approval' state. HOD authenticated.
action_or_input: HOD rejects the proposal with remarks.
expected_result: Proposal marked Rejected and current department data is retained unchanged.

purpose: Verify HOD oversight and resolution of feedback after initial review.
preconditions: Feedback in 'Under Review' status. HOD authenticated.
action_or_input: HOD resolves feedback with resolution notes.
expected_result: Feedback marked 'RESOLVED' (or 'CLOSED') and submitter is notified.

purpose: Verify HOD reviews feedback without changing terminal status.
preconditions: Feedback in 'Under Review' status. HOD authenticated.
action_or_input: HOD views feedback details and adds internal notes without closing.
expected_result: Feedback remains in reviewed non-terminal state ('UNDER_REVIEW').

purpose: Verify Student views basic permitted profile info for peer and faculty.
preconditions: Student authenticated.
action_or_input: Student requests profile details.
expected_result: Returns basic permitted information (name, role, email); sensitive details excluded.

purpose: Verify Faculty views detailed student profile for students enrolled in their course.
preconditions: Faculty authenticated. Student is enrolled in Faculty course.
action_or_input: Faculty requests enrolled student profile.
expected_result: Returns detailed academic student profile information.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin and HOD view full profiles.
preconditions: Dept_Admin or HOD authenticated.
action_or_input: Requests department user profile.
expected_result: Returns full profile details.

purpose: Verify Faculty receives only limited information for student not in their courses.
preconditions: Student is NOT enrolled in Faculty's courses. Faculty authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty requests student profile.
expected_result: Detailed course/academic information is withheld; only basic permitted info returned.

source_id: UC-DEPT-015 Alternative Flow Sensitive Data Protection
purpose: Verify sensitive personal data is excluded from HOD/Admin profile views per privacy policy.
preconditions: Dept_Admin requests profile containing protected personal data.
action_or_input: Query profile details.
expected_result: Sensitive personal data (e.g. personal contact numbers) is protected/masked.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin manages department user profiles.
preconditions: Dept_Admin authenticated. User profile exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin updates profile attributes.
expected_result: Profile attributes updated successfully.

purpose: Verify profile update validation failure.
preconditions: Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits invalid profile payload.
expected_result: Update rejected (400 Bad Request) and invalid changes are not applied.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin manages lab profiles.
preconditions: Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin updates lab profile equipment and supervisor details.
expected_result: Lab profile updated successfully.

purpose: Verify lab profile update validation failure.
preconditions: Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits invalid lab profile data.
expected_result: Update rejected (400 Bad Request) and not saved.

purpose: Verify Student views academic program information and applicable timetable.
preconditions: Student authenticated. Program and timetable information published.
action_or_input: Student requests program and timetable views.
expected_result: Academic program info and applicable class schedule returned.

purpose: Verify empty state when no timetable or program data is published for student.
preconditions: No timetable data published for student's program/semester.
action_or_input: Student queries timetable.
expected_result: System displays empty/unavailable state without error.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin manages inventory records.
preconditions: Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin creates new inventory item with initial quantity.
expected_result: Item created in inventory and immutable insertion log entry appended.

purpose: Verify invalid stock data is rejected during inventory management.
preconditions: Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits stock item with negative quantity or missing item name.
expected_result: Action rejected (400 Bad Request) with validation feedback; inventory remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify Institute Admin maintains department role assignments.
preconditions: Institute Admin authenticated. Valid employee and tenure specified.
action_or_input: Institute Admin assigns HOD role for valid validity period.
expected_result: Role assignment recorded successfully.

purpose: Verify proposed role assignment violating unique active-role cardinality is blocked.
preconditions: An active HOD assignment already exists for the department.
action_or_input: Institute Admin attempts to record an overlapping concurrent active HOD assignment without transition.
expected_result: System blocks assignment (400 Bad Request or 409 Conflict) preserving cardinality.

purpose: Verify system applies effective department role transition.
preconditions: Reassignment reaches effective date/time with outgoing and incoming holders.
action_or_input: System applies role transition event.
expected_result: Outgoing holder's access is revoked, incoming holder's access is granted, and displayed Headship is synchronized.

purpose: Verify initial role assignment transition when no outgoing holder exists.
preconditions: Department has no current active role holder. Reassignment takes effect.
action_or_input: System applies role transition event.
expected_result: Outgoing revocation is skipped, incoming role access is granted, and unique active role is preserved.
